content: {"kind":"plan","text":"按 20 分钟排：先用俯卧 Y-T-W 和俯撑肩胛前伸唤醒肩胛、前锯肌，再练肩袖外旋、俯撑触肩、平行杆锁肘支撑和直臂侧平板，最后用腕部摇摆收尾。场所默认居家，没提难度就按入门排；两个器械都用上了。","plan":{"schemaVersion":1,"source":"ai","title":"支撑肩稳定 20 分","summary":"肩袖+前锯肌+锁肘支撑，练托马斯承重肩的稳定","goal":"strength","scene":"home","equipment":["mat","band","parallettes"],"level":1,"targetMinutes":20,"avoid":[],"blocks":[{"id":"b1","name":"热身","type":"warmup","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"scapular-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":8,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"serratus-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":10,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":30}]},{"id":"b2","name":"主训练","type":"main","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"rotator-cuff-B","mode":"reps","sets":3,"reps":12,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"rotator-cuff-A","mode":"reps","sets":3,"reps":8,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"triceps-B","mode":"time","sets":3,"workSeconds":15,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":45},{"exerciseId":"deltoids-A","mode":"time","sets":3,"workSeconds":25,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30}]},{"id":"b3","name":"放松 · 腕与肩","type":"cooldown","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"forearms-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":10,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":15}]}],"notes":["平行杆所有支撑都保持锁肘、肩往下压，不要塌肩","外旋用轻阻力慢速做，4 秒回程"],"safetyNotes":["手腕或肩出现疼痛、刺痛就立刻停下"]}}
